rules.title: Annual allowable rent increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the annual allowable rent increase from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent. The dollar amount is calculated by multiplying the base rent by .016.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.conflict_note: The document also states the prior period's amount (1.4% for March 1, 2025 through February 28, 2026), which has been superseded by the 1.6% amount.
